title: Entrance Test(s) scheduled to be held on 22/09/2026 (vide Notification No. : SFC/308/26 Dated : 16/09/2026) is rescheduled to 23/09/2026 (Wednesday)
text:
KEY LINES:
Notice No. : SFC/310/26 Dated : 17/09/2026
Notification No. : SFC/308/26 Dated : 16/09/2026) shall be rescheduled to 23rd September

FULL TEXT:
RABINDRA BHARATI UNIVERSITY
Emerald Bower Campus: 56 A B.T. Road, Kolkata-700050
Jora Sanko Campus: 6/4 Dwarakanath Tagore Lane, Kolkata-700007
Notice No. : SFC/310/26 Dated : 17/09/2026
Notice
It is hereby notified for information of all concerned that 22nd September 2026 (Tuesday) has
been declared as a holiday by the competent authority.
Accordingly, the Entrance Test(s) scheduled to be held on 22nd September 2026(vide
Notification No. : SFC/308/26 Dated : 16/09/2026) shall be rescheduled to 23rd September
2026 (Wednesday).
The time, venue and all other terms, conditions and instructions relating to the said Entrance
Test(s) shall remain unchanged.
All concerned candidates are advised to take note of the above change and appear for the
Entrance Test on the rescheduled date accordingly.
Sd/-
Secretary, Faculty Councils
